title: MIRAGE WSI Processing Pipeline Parameters
description: Schema synchronized with nextflow.config canonical params surface.

input.description: Path to input samplesheet or directory.

stop.description: Pipeline step to stop after. If null, runs to the end.

mode.description: Execution mode, recorded in qc/run_summary.json. Only 'standard' (the linear start/stop step flow) exists on this branch; the dev branch adds 'add_cycle' (incremental cyclic-IF).

skip_preprocessing.description: Skip BaSiC illumination correction entirely (the default). Images are still converted to standardised OME-TIFF; the preprocessed checkpoint then records the converted image. Set false to run the correction.

preproc_skip_nuclear.description: Skip BaSiC correction on the nuclear/fiducial channels named by nuclear_markers. Those channels drive registration and segmentation, so correcting them changes what both consume.

preproc_tile_size.description: BaSiC FOV tile size in pixels.

preprocess_qc_scale_factor.description: Scale factor for preprocessing QC images.

skip_preprocess_qc.description: Skip preprocessing quality control image generation.

pixel_size.description: Micrometres per pixel. Defaults to 'auto', which reads PhysicalSizeX from each image's own OME metadata (a preflight step fails the run if that metadata is absent or unusable); pass a positive number to override the metadata for every slide. Owns every micrometre conversion in the pipeline.

registration_method.description: Registration backend: 'valis' (VALIS graph-based whole-slide) or 'tiled' (STARE: JVM-free, internally tiled, fully parallel). See lib/ParamUtils.groovy.

nuclear_markers.description: Ordered preference of nuclear/fiducial marker names; the first present (resolved from channel metadata, never the filename) is moved to channel 0 and drives both cell segmentation and the registration fiducial. Accepts a list (config/params file) or a comma- or space-separated string, which is the only shape Nextflow can produce for `--nuclear_markers CELLTOX` on the command line; MarkerUtils.markerList normalises both.

skip_registration_qc.description: Skip registration quality control (legacy; equivalent to reg_qc=0).

reg_qc.description: Registration QC depth: 0=none, 1=DAPI overlay only, 2=DAPI overlay + segmentation-overlap metrics (per-pair IoU, dice_matched, centroid residuals).

qc_scale_factor.description: Scale factor for registration QC images.

seg_qc_pairing.description: reg_qc=2 cell correspondence: 'lsa' (optimal one-to-one assignment within the match radius) or 'mutual_nn' (greedy mutual nearest neighbour).

seg_qc_match_radius_factor.description: reg_qc=2 match radius in median nuclear radii; applies to both pairing methods.

memory_mode.description: VALIS cost/accuracy tier. Table: bin/utils/valis_config.py MEMORY_PRESETS. 'custom' starts from 'high' and applies the reg_valis_* overrides you set.

reg_valis_max_processed_dim.description: VALIS feature detection/matching working size (px). null = from memory_mode. Only legal with memory_mode=custom.

reg_valis_max_non_rigid_dim.description: VALIS non-rigid registration size (px). null = from memory_mode. Only legal with memory_mode=custom. Must be smaller than the full resolution of every slide: VALIS 1.0.0-1.2.0 reads a slide no larger than this at pyramid level -1 and kills its JVM (its own clamp does not prevent it), so REGISTER refuses such input at start. Lower it below the smallest slide on small-format input such as TMA cores, with a margin.

reg_valis_max_keypoints.description: Keypoints kept per image for SuperPoint detection and SuperGlue matching in REGISTER. null = VALIS's own 20000. SuperGlue's cost is quadratic in this; the tma profile lowers it to 2000. Lowering it changes which matches exist, so registrations at different values are not comparable.

reg_micro_reg.description: Micro-registration depth (nested, default 1): 0=none, 1=micro-rigid only (refines slide.M) [default], 2=+micro non-rigid (register_micro).

reg_jvm_heap_gb.description: JVM heap (GiB) for VALIS/Bio-Formats in REGISTER. null = derive from task.memory at runtime.

reg_tiled_mode.description: STARE/tiled cost/accuracy tier. Table: lib/RegPresets.groovy RegPresets.STARE. 'custom' starts from 'high' and applies the reg_tiled_* overrides you set.

reg_tiled_nuclear_index.description: STARE (registration_method=tiled) only: nuclear/fiducial channel index used to estimate the transform. null = resolve from channel metadata against nuclear_markers.

reg_tiled_tile.description: tile core size (px); also the mesh grid resolution. null = from reg_tiled_mode.

reg_tiled_halo.description: tile read halo (px). null = from reg_tiled_mode.

reg_tiled_gate_tre.description: STARE only: refine only tiles whose rigid-stage TRE (px) exceeds this.

reg_tiled_max_error.description: STARE only: confidence gate. Drop a mesh control point whose phase-correlation error exceeds this (0 = perfect match, ~1 = no shared structure). Keeps background and section-edge tiles out of the deformation mesh.

reg_tiled_max_disp.description: STARE only: range gate. Drop a mesh control point whose displacement magnitude (px) is at or beyond this. null = use reg_tiled_halo, the read-window bound.

reg_tiled_upsample.description: phase-correlation sub-pixel upsample factor. null = from reg_tiled_mode.

reg_tiled_out_tile.description: streaming stitch write-tile size (px). null = from reg_tiled_mode.

reg_tiled_coarse_max_dim.description: COARSE anchor thumbnail longest side (px). null = from reg_tiled_mode.

seg_n_tiles_y.description: Number of tiles in Y direction for segmentation.

seg_n_tiles_x.description: Number of tiles in X direction for segmentation.

seg_method.description: Segmentation backend to use. 'instantseg' (default) runs without extra assets; 'stardist' requires a trained model via segmentation_model_dir unless segmentation_model names a StarDist built-in.

seg_prob_thresh.description: StarDist detection probability threshold. null = use the model's built-in default.

seg_instantseg_model.description: InstanSeg model name (only used when seg_method='instantseg').

seg_instantseg_target.description: InstanSeg output target. Only 'all_outputs' is accepted: 'cells' and 'nuclei' each return a SINGLE label map, and this pipeline derives Cytoplasm = Cell - Nucleus, which would be empty for every cell if the nuclei and cell masks were the same array. bin/segment_instantseg.py refuses a single map; the enum is narrowed so the refusal happens at launch instead of inside a segmentation task.

seg_instantseg_tile_size.description: Tile size (px) for InstanSeg tiled inference.

seg_instantseg_batch_size.description: Number of tiles per InstanSeg forward pass.

instanseg_model_dir.description: Writable host path for InstanSeg's BioImage.IO model cache. null = per-task work-dir cache.

seg_cellsam_use_wsi.description: Enable CellSAM native tiling (block_size/overlap) for large images.

cellsam_model_path.description: Path to pre-downloaded CellSAM weights for offline/container use. null = auto-download at runtime.

quantify_compartments.description: Quantify signal per compartment (Nucleus / Cytoplasm / Cell) by routing the nuclear mask into QUANTIFY alongside the whole-cell mask, and emit both segmentations into the GeoJSON. Cytoplasm = whole-cell minus nucleus.

expanded_quantification.description: With quantify_compartments, also emit Mean and Sum (integrated density) per compartment; per-compartment Median is always emitted. Requires quantify_compartments.

simplify_tolerance.description: Douglas-Peucker simplification tolerance (px) applied to exported GeoJSON cell/nucleus polygons. The exported polygon is display-only (quantification is mask-derived), so simplifying it does not affect analysis.

geojson_coord_precision.description: Decimal places retained for GeoJSON polygon coordinates on export.

skip_postprocessing_qc.description: Skip postprocessing quality control (segmentation overlay, cell stats, intensity distributions).

skip_seg_quality_eval.description: Skip reference-free cell-segmentation quality scoring (CellSegmentationEvaluator, 2D). Default true: the scorer is opt-in because its `segeval` container is only published on a release or manual dispatch.

cse_pixel_size_um.description: Pixel size in micrometers passed to the CellSegmentationEvaluator. null = infer from image metadata.

cse_max_pixels.description: Bin image+masks so CSE scores at most this many pixels, capping its memory/time on full-WSI masks (the pixel size is scaled to match, preserving geometry/area metrics). null = score at full resolution. Keep fixed across a cohort: the composite QualityScore shifts with the binning factor.

skip_final_qc_report.description: Skip generation of the final aggregated HTML QC report.

skip_spatialdata_export.help_text: The scverse-native store is additive; the pyramidal OME-TIFF and QuPath GeoJSON remain the primary outputs.

spatialdata_include_image.description: Write the merged pyramid into the SpatialData store.
spatialdata_include_image.help_text: spatialdata.write() materializes every element, so this duplicates the largest artifact the pipeline produces. Off by default; turn on for a self-contained, depositable object.

spatialdata_residual_join_max_px.description: Max centroid distance (px) when joining registration QC residuals onto cell_mask.
spatialdata_residual_join_max_px.help_text: The reg-QC segmentation is a separate native-image run and shares no label space with cell_mask, so the join is spatial.

tilex.description: Tile size (px, square) for OME-TIFF output.

pyramid_resolutions.description: Number of pyramid resolution levels for OME-TIFF output.

pyramid_scale.description: Scale factor between pyramid levels. Must be at least 2: a factor of 1 is not a pyramid (every level would be the base), and MERGE_AND_PYRAMID's memory closure divides by 1 - 1/scale^2, which is 0 at scale 1 (Infinity -> a ~2 EB request) and NaN at scale 0 (a 0 GB request).

embed_masks.description: When true and quantify_compartments + expanded_quantification are also enabled, embed the cell + nuclei segmentation masks as a second, single-resolution uint32 OME series (Image:1) inside the pyramid OME-TIFF. The masks then travel with the pyramid, for any consumer that reads Image:1 back out of it.

dry_run.description: Run pipeline in dry-run mode without executing processes.

cleanup_level.description: Which published outputs a run keeps. 'none' (default) publishes everything; 'final' publishes only the final artifacts.
cleanup_level.help_text: 'none' (the default) publishes everything, so the run's output can be RE-ENTERED: '--start segmentation' reads registered/, and '--mode add_cycle' reads registered/ and the segmentation masks. 'final' publishes only pyramid/, geojson/, quantification/ and the SpatialData .zarr per patient, plus run-level qc/, csv/ and size_logs/; intermediates are never published rather than published-then-deleted (publishDir uses mode: 'copy', so the delete variant pays a full copy out of the work directory for a file nobody reads), and add_cycle is refused at launch at that level. The surviving/dropped split is owned by Layout.FINAL_KINDS.

cleanup_work.description: Delete the Nextflow work directory after a successful run. Mutually exclusive with -resume.
cleanup_work.help_text: On by default. Nextflow removes the work directory once the run completes SUCCESSFULLY; a failed run keeps it, so failure evidence always survives. Published outputs are unaffected (every publishDir uses mode: 'copy'), and step restarts via --start still work because checkpoint CSVs never record paths inside the work directory. Do not combine with -resume: a cleaned run has no cache to resume from, and the pipeline warns at launch when both are in play. This shipped off while the QC errorStrategy could drop a failed task silently -- a run could exit 0 with a task failed and nothing left to look at. That branch is gone: a broken QC task now fails the run.

config_profile_name.description: Human-readable name for the active config profile (e.g. set by conf/test.config). Not read by pipeline code.

config_profile_description.description: Human-readable description for the active config profile (e.g. set by conf/test.config). Not read by pipeline code.

slurm_partition.description: SLURM partition to submit jobs to.

gpu_type.description: GRES string for GPU jobs, rendered as --gres=gpu:<value>. Bare '1' means any one GPU and is portable; set a typed string (e.g. 'nvidia_a100:1') in your site config to match `sinfo -o "%G"`.

concurrency.description: Drives both max_forks and queue_size together, preserving the shipped 5:20 ratio (queue_size = concurrency * 4). The single knob to tune for overall cluster throughput.
concurrency.help_text: max_forks and queue_size are only meaningful together -- the lower of the two binds, so raising one alone changes nothing. Set max_forks and/or queue_size individually to override this ratio for the asymmetric case.

max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent tasks per process. Also an upper bound on every per-process maxForks in conf/modules.config, so lowering it throttles every module. null = derive from concurrency.
max_forks.help_text: Paired with queue_size, which caps concurrency across the WHOLE pipeline. The lower of the two binds: at the defaults max_forks (5, from concurrency) is far below queue_size (20), so raising queue_size alone has no effect. Raise max_forks (or concurrency), or both.

queue_size.description: Maximum concurrent tasks across the whole pipeline (executor.queueSize). null = derive from concurrency (concurrency * 4).
queue_size.help_text: This is normally the binding constraint on concurrency, not max_forks -- except at the shipped defaults, where max_forks (5) is the smaller of the two and binds instead. The shipped default of 20 is deliberately conservative for a shared scheduler.
